title: Clock literacy

D0.outcome: Explains how the clock works (whose clock runs, increment, flag fall) and what a flag fall means.

D1.outcome: Plays a ten-minute game, presses the clock correctly, and finishes without losing on time.

D2.outcome: In ten timed games, reports the time left at the end of the opening and of the middlegame, and finishes without flagging.

D3.outcome: Adjusts moves to the time left, shortening the long thinks on routine moves.

misconceptions: Time matters only at the end of the game.
conditions: Timed play with a clock displayed.
contrasts: Spending a long time on book moves in the opening.
Moving so fast that the safety scan is skipped.
